profile_text.body:
Genpact LTD is listed as a public company trading under the ticker G, with CIK 0001398659 and headquarters in Hamilton. The website associated with the company is generali.com.

The text drawn from that site describes Assicurazioni Generali Group rather than Genpact. According to that text, the site is the corporate website of the Generali Group, covering its activities, financial data, news, corporate social responsibility, career opportunities, and history. It also refers to a plan called "Lifetime Partner 27: Driving Excellence," which the company describes as intended to enhance excellence across customer relationships, its group operating model, and its core capabilities.

No AI products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are listed for Genpact LTD, so there is no documented AI product line or litigation to report.
